title: Finite primary decomposition of a generic abelian sheaf
statement: Let K be a field and M a torsion abelian etale sheaf on Spec K [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves, def-weil-pbc-torsion-etale-sheaf] with finite geometric stalk [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. There exist r, primes p_i, and sheaves N_i with finite p_i-primary geometric stalk, with maps a_i:M -> N_i and b_i:N_i -> M such that the sum of a_i followed by b_i is the identity of M. The zero sheaf admits r=0.

proof.text: Apply the abelian stalk/Galois-module equivalence to obtain a finite continuous abelian Galois module V.
Apply Rep.exists_finite_primary_decomposition to the finite discrete representation supplied by the equivalence.

Transport V_i, their inclusions and projections back through the additive equivalence, conjugating by its unit. Additivity gives the sum identity and the stalk comparison gives the finite and primary conditions.

proof_origin.note: U2: complete Lean transport of the finite representation decomposition through the equivalence and stalk comparison.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finite_primary_sheaf_decomposition
    (K : Type u) [Field K]
    (M : Sheaf (Spec (.of K)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (hM : M.IsTorsion)
    (hfinite : Finite (((pointSmallEtale
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure K))))).sheafFiber
        (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj M)) :
    ∃ (r : ℕ) (p : Fin r → ℕ)
      (N : Fin r → Sheaf (Spec (.of K)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}),
      (∀ i, (p i).Prime) ∧
      (∀ i, Finite (((pointSmallEtale
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure K))))).sheafFiber
          (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj (N i))) ∧
      (∀ i, IsPGroup (p i) (Multiplicative (((pointSmallEtale
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (AlgebraicClosure K))))).sheafFiber
          (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj (N i)))) ∧
      ∃ (a : ∀ i, M ⟶ N i) (b : ∀ i, N i ⟶ M),
        ∑ i, a i ≫ b i = 𝟙 M
